A word ending with the Ablative -5th case-affix is optionally compounded with the word भय 'fear' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष
The 5th case-affix (Ablative) is used when a word is governed by the following कर्मप्रवचनीयाः

i.e. अप , आङ् and परि।

Terms: विभक्ति-5

The 5th case-affix is used when the thing specified is different or divided from (and not included in) that from which specification is intended.

Terms: विभक्ति-5

The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when the word, in composition with it is in the Ablative -5th case, which does not denote a genus.

Terms: ड

The words 1. पञ्चत् and 2. दशत् in combination with वर्ग may be anomalously so formed, in the sense of 'this is its measure'.

Terms: ख

The affix तसिल् (तस्) comes after the word किम् , a सर्वनाम and बहु when ending in Ablative -5th case.

Terms: तसिल्

The Ablative -5th case-ending after स्तोक etc. is not elided before the second member of a compound.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision

अत्‌ is substituted for the Ablative -5th case ending भ्यस् after the अङ्ग (stems) युष्मद् and अस्मद्।

Terms: Some substitution

The विसर्ग of the Ablative -5th case is changed to स् before परि meaning 'over'.

Terms: विसर्ग सन्धि
